result.head: a082bbed77f517844038996ef650562b4b8db35b
result.title: Service-owned canvas history and externalized diagram persistence
result.description: Implement architecture at a082bbed: replace workspace overview to separate injected DiagramService, canonical history and compatibility read models; extend Diagram and controller diagrams; add service/history, ChangeSession isolation and record-persistence details; migrate history and catalog responsibilities. Preserve grid/floating diagrams and originals. No acceptance or publication.

changes.title: Replace workspace hierarchy: injected services, canonical composition and compatibility projections
Reconnect unchanged GridBox detail to canonical scene.root
Extend Diagram with immutable revision ownership and logical-node views
Reconnect unchanged FloatingBox detail to the retained display model
Unify UI and agent coordination; delegate history and expose proposal owner
Add DiagramService contexts and canonical durable history detail
Add forked ChangeSession history and independent preview detail
Separate catalog publication from diagram ownership and extend workspace/session persistence
Add CanvasCatalogStore and immutable content-addressed record persistence

migrations.title: Controller-local history becomes service-owned canonical history
migrations.description: Feature-ownership migration: the controller delegates undo, redo and reset to DiagramService; CanvasHistory behind that service owns checkpoints, revision bindings and durable navigation. The controller remains the edit coordinator and materialized-view adapter.

migrations.title: CanvasCatalogStore takes over catalog publication responsibilities
migrations.description: Feature-ownership migration: representation catalog load/save, mapping and projection saves, serialization and archive move into CanvasCatalogStore. ProjectCatalogStore remains its compatibility subclass and retains compaction APIs. The catalogPersistence helper extraction is only code organization, not an additional feature takeover.
